proposals.name: CoolWithoutSpecifiedEndpoint
proposals.reason: Both quotations report cooling without an endpoint. HeatChill requires a numerical temperature; the extension contracts also require unreported parameters and are not identical-contract aliases.

effects: Lowers the temperature of the vessel contents without asserting a particular endpoint.
guards: Leave endpoint, method, and duration unknown unless reported.
Keep endpoint-free cooling distinct from cooling to room temperature.

proposals.name: CoolToQualitativeTemperature
proposals.reason: Both quotations specify cooling to RT. HeatChill requires temp_C and cannot retain this qualitative endpoint without an invented number. The supplied string and quantity contracts are not identical.

effects: Cools the mixture toward the reported qualitative temperature target.
guards: Preserve RT as a qualitative target rather than assigning a numerical temperature.
Do not infer a cooling method or duration.

proposals.name: GloveBox
proposals.reason: Both quotations explicitly identify an argon-filled glove box. No existing apparatus family covers this enclosure type. Shared family membership does not establish interchangeable devices or identify a manufacturer or model.

proposals.name: Atmosphere
proposals.reason: The existing environment mode represents the reported argon glove-box context. Retain gas=argon and mode=environment; do not infer a purge, evacuation, or gas-establishment procedure. Vessel identity requires contextual resolution.

proposals.name: Evaporate
proposals.reason: Both reports remove volatile inventory, matching Evaporate. Preserve THF and qualitative reduced pressure in the first report without inventing pressure_mbar; do not transfer that pressure condition to the second report or infer temperature and duration.

proposals.name: DegasMaterial
proposals.reason: Gas removal from solids or a mixture is not equivalent to establishing a vessel atmosphere. The device-labeled observation describes an operation, not identified hardware. Neither a technique nor a known-operation macro is supported.

effects: Removes gas from the stated material.
guards: Preserve solids versus mixture as the reported material role.
Preserve 'again' as repetition without inventing a cycle count or an earlier event.
Do not infer vacuum, gas flow, freeze-pump-thaw cycles, or apparatus.

proposals.name: DiscardMaterial
proposals.reason: All four reports discard identified experimental material. Transfer requires endpoints and quantity and does not encode disposal; DiscontinueExperiment explicitly asserts no physical change. Differing required extension fields prevent identical-contract aliases.

effects: Removes the specified material from retained experimental material for disposal.
guards: Preserve the reported material scope: reaction mixture, mixture, or sample.
Do not infer quenching, pretreatment, disposal method, destination, or quantity.
Do not treat disposal as mere discontinuation.

proposals.name: Filter
proposals.reason: These quotations describe filtration through the reported Celite medium or pad, matching Filter.through. The device-labeled records do not identify a funnel, holder, or driving mode. Vessel and retained stream remain unresolved; do not infer keep=solid or keep=filtrate or claim executable instances.

proposals.name: SetHeatingBlockTemperature
proposals.reason: The existing candidate distinguishes the reported preheated block at 80 °C from sample temperature. HeatChill on the reaction vessel would conflate those endpoints. This reuses candidate semantics only and does not establish execution support.

proposals.name: Stir
proposals.reason: The same quotation separately reports stirring the mixture for 12 h, matching Stir with duration_s=43200. Block temperature is not a measured mixture temperature, and no stirring rate is reported.

proposals.name: DiscontinueExperiment
proposals.reason: The existing candidate already represents abandonment of further processing without an asserted physical termination method. The quotation supports reported_statement='Reaction abandoned.' and reaction-level scope, not cooling, quenching, or disposal. Candidate reuse does not make it executable.

proposals.name: Purify
proposals.reason: Reported column chromatography matches the existing opaque terminal Purify operation. Preserve the reported DCM:MeOH 90:10 method description without inferring its ratio basis, column geometry, or a second purification.

proposals.name: CombineSolutionsByMultiAspiration
proposals.reason: The quotation explicitly combines four source-plate components by multi-aspiration before dispensing. Add and Transfer do not retain this liquid-handler mode and intermediate combination state; no approved lossless macro or roundtrip witnesses are supplied.

effects: Combines the reported component aliquots by multi-aspiration to form the mixture subsequently dispensed.
guards: Preserve the reported Mosquito designation without inferring manufacturer or model.
Preserve four components and 250 nL per component.
Do not infer source-well assignments, intermediate hardware, or mixing cycles.
Do not duplicate the subsequent 1 uL dispensing event.

proposals.name: DispenseMixtureWithLiquidHandler
proposals.reason: The final dosing phase introduces 1 uL of the resulting mixture into a 1536-well plate using the reported device. Add does not explicitly preserve the liquid-handler mode, while Transfer requires an unreported source endpoint. This is distinct from the existing per-well distribution candidate.

effects: Dispenses the specified mixture volume into the reported destination using the stated liquid handler.
guards: Preserve the reported 1 uL dose separately from the preceding multi-aspiration.
Plate capacity does not establish occupied wells, dose count, or total dispensed volume.
Do not infer a source location or destination-well assignment.
Do not infer manufacturer or model from the reported device designation.

proposals.name: DissolveMaterials
proposals.reason: Both quotations report dissolution of charged materials in 1.5 mL toluene. Add alone does not assert dissolution, and Stir cannot guarantee that endpoint. No reported technique or approved lossless macro supports decomposition into known operations.

effects: Represents the reported dissolution of charged materials in the specified solvent.
guards: Preserve the reported solvent volume.
Do not infer a separate solvent-addition event, agitation technique, duration, or apparatus.

proposals.name: AddSolventAndDissolve
proposals.reason: The supplied extension explicitly includes both solvent addition and dissolution. Add captures only the first effect, while dissolution-only semantics omit the inventory change. No approved macro using known operations preserves both effects.

effects: Dissolves the existing mixture in that solvent.
guards: Preserve DMF and the reported 0.5 mL volume.
Do not infer stirring, duration, or a dissolution technique.
Do not duplicate the solvent charge as another Add event.

proposals.name: Stir
proposals.reason: The phrase reports a stirred solution, matching Stir semantics. It supplies neither duration_s nor rpm; retain the unresolved required duration rather than inventing a value or treating this as an executable instance.

proposals.name: Wait
proposals.reason: The reported 16 h interval matches elapsed-time semantics with duration_s=57600, without implying stirring or heating. The reported conversion is a separate analytical finding, not a Wait effect.

proposals.name: RecordAnalyticalObservation
proposals.reason: The existing candidate records composition findings without changing material inventory. Preserve the reported 88% conversion with method unspecified; do not infer an analytical procedure, isolated yield, or additional processing. This remains candidate-only reuse.

proposals.name: BathDry
proposals.reason: The existing BathDry candidate covers oil-bath drying at a bath temperature of 90 °C for 1800 s. Parameter names and number-versus-quantity representations differ, so these are semantic reuse rather than identical-contract aliases. Do not equate bath and sample temperatures or inherit pressure from preceding steps; execution remains unsupported.

proposals.name: FlashChromatographyApparatus
proposals.reason: The explicit flash column chromatography report supports a generic apparatus type absent from the family registry, not a specific instrument. Stationary phase, dimensions, manufacturer, and model remain unknown; family membership does not establish interchangeability.

proposals.name: Add
proposals.reason: The quantified reagent charge matches Add's material-introduction semantics. Preserve both reported mass and molar amount; the quoted span alone leaves the vessel and charging context to be resolved rather than supplying invented values.

proposals.name: GasChromatographyMassSpectrometryAnalyzer
proposals.reason: Both observations identify GC/MS analysis and support the same generic apparatus family, which is absent from the registry. Neither identifies a manufacturer, model, configuration, or interchangeable instrument.

proposals.name: ChromatographicElution
proposals.reason: The existing ChromatographicElution candidate captures the linked physical phase but requires a stationary phase and percentage composition absent here. Extend the candidate contract to retain the reported 1:1 ratio without converting it to an unsupported percentage basis; whole-process Purify and condition-only attachment remain distinct.

effects: Represents elution through a chromatography column within the referenced purification.
guards: Preserve the reported Hep:EA order and 1:1 ratio without inferring its basis.
Retain the reported solvent abbreviations without unsupported expansion.
Do not infer stationary phase, flow, eluent volume, fraction selection, or column geometry.
Do not count this linked phase as another purification run.

proposals.name: EstablishGasAtmosphereByUnspecifiedMethod
proposals.reason: The quotation reports placement under nitrogen but no actual establishment method. Atmosphere requires mode; choosing purge, evacuation/refill, balloon, or environment would add unsupported method or context semantics.

effects: Places the vessel contents under the stated gas atmosphere by an unspecified method.
guards: Preserve nitrogen identity.
Do not infer purging, evacuation cycles, gas-delivery hardware, or duration.
Keep atmosphere establishment distinct from the preceding degassing action.

proposals.name: EstablishUnspecifiedInertAtmosphere
proposals.reason: The report specifies inert-atmosphere establishment and qualitative extent but neither gas identity nor method. Atmosphere requires both gas and mode; the gas-specific establishment candidate also requires an identified gas.

effects: Establishes the reported inert atmosphere around the vessel contents.
guards: Preserve the qualitative extent 'thoroughly' without converting it to cycles or duration.
Leave gas identity and establishment method unknown.
Do not infer purging, evacuation, or a gas-delivery arrangement.
